与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:艾米的经历、感受与成长。
The river bank looked quieter than usual that evening. Amy thanked Tom for the honest advice. On Thursday evenings, Amy reviews the notes from class. For example, ducks swim on the village pond.

Amy ordered chicken and water at the plant garden last night. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. For example, permafrost underlies the tundra.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The plant garden has become an important part of daily life. Amy will take part in a chess match in February. Best of all, mulching locks moisture into beds.
At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. Amy believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. What's more, blue hour suits lit shopfronts.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Amy has practiced chess for three years and won a prize last term. Little by little, things began to change.
